name: Gmail Email — Read
author: hearth-team
description: Read email from your Gmail inbox via Google OAuth. action='digest' returns recent mail WITH content (sender, subject, snippet) in one call — ideal for a morning brief; also search (ids), get (one message body), labels. Uses the minimum-privilege gmail.readonly scope — this skill physically cannot send email or modify your mailbox. Pair with Gmail Email — Send for outbound.

vault_inputs.label: Google OAuth client ID
vault_inputs.help: One-time setup: console.cloud.google.com → New Project → APIs & Services → Library → enable 'Gmail API' → Credentials → Create Credentials → OAuth client ID → Application type 'Web application' → add 'https://developers.google.com/oauthplayground' as an Authorized redirect URI. Paste the resulting Client ID here. Same client serves Gmail Read + Gmail Send + future Workspace skills.

vault_inputs.label: Google OAuth client secret
vault_inputs.help: The 'Client secret' shown next to the Client ID in the Cloud Console Credentials list. Stored encrypted in your vault. If you ever rotate it, paste the new value here and click Save.

vault_inputs.label: Gmail read refresh token
vault_inputs.help: Generate at developers.google.com/oauthplayground: (1) gear icon → check 'Use your own OAuth credentials' → paste Client ID + secret. (2) Step 1 → find 'Gmail API v1' → tick ONLY 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly' (no other scopes — keeps this token read-only). (3) Authorize, accept consent. (4) Step 2 → Exchange authorization code → copy the Refresh token here.
